ota.url.description: Base URL of the OS image update source: the update window reads <url>/latest-<arch>.json there.

ota.auto_check.description: Check the update source now and then (about ten minutes after start and every six hours); a new update is announced, and installed only if ota.auto_update is on.

ota.auto_update.description: Install updates automatically: a service downloads and installs a newer signed update in the background (it starts at the next restart). Needs ota.auto_check.

system.developer_mode.description: Enable developer features. Changing it requires administrator authentication.

apps.default_apps.description: Applications installed automatically, once, when the computer is first online: Flatpak ids separated by spaces (the app store by default; empty for none). One you remove is not installed again.

identity.enabled.description: Offer sign-in with an identity provider (Ersa ID by default). Off: no identity features, and nothing contacts the provider.

identity.issuer.description: The OpenID Connect provider's issuer address (https://...). Ersa ID by default. A company sets its own here or in a preseed file; empty means no provider.

identity.client_id.description: This computer's client id at the identity provider (a public client: no secret). Ersa ID's by default; set it together with identity.issuer.

identity.scopes.description: Scopes asked for at sign-in, separated by spaces.

devices.enabled.description: Report this computer's health to the Ersa ID account it is linked to (about once a day, with the update check). Nothing is sent until the person links the computer; foundation devices show lists exactly what is sent.

devices.url.description: The account service this computer links to and reports to. Changing it needs the config authorization; a linked computer keeps reporting to the address it linked with until it is unlinked.
